utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Dane, I’m still piecing together the repair drive from what folks have told me—have you heard where the sign-up or drop-off list is being kept?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hi Nell — I’m a little late to the details too, but I know the collection table is set for Saturday morning; I’m checking now where the sign-up and drop-off list is being kept.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Dane—that’s more than I had. If you find out where the list is, could you let me know so I can pass along any names or broken items people mention?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Opal, I’m lining up the repair drive now—I’ve got Faye penciled in for 2:30 to 3:15 and I’m drafting the volunteer sign-up sheet today.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, Mara—please mark Faye at 2:30 to 3:15 on the station map too, and leave a column on the sign-up sheet for where each volunteer and any tools will be stationed.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, Opal—I’ll add Faye to the station map for 2:30 to 3:15 and include columns on the sign-up sheet for each volunteer’s station and tools.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Noah, I checked with Eli and it sounds like screwdrivers, pliers, and a socket set are the big needs so far—I’ve got those ready to bring when the list is firmed up.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: That’s perfect, Gus—Saturday morning at the community shed is what Leo told me, so those tools sound right on target. I’ll keep my ears open in case the list changes.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, thanks Noah—I’ll plan on bringing the toolbox to the community shed Saturday morning, and if you hear they need cords or a work light too, just give me a shout.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Vik, thanks again for checking the start time—my memory’s a sieve today. I’ve kept the day free and I’m ready to help once you know when we’re kicking off.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Oren — I’m still waiting on Cleo to confirm the exact time with the organizers, but I’ll let you know as soon as I hear so you’re not guessing.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik, that’s kind of you. I’ll stay put and wait for your note—if I wander off, just remind me it’s the porch steps and gutters.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hi Kira, I’m still gathering the confirmed time and supply list, but I’m asking around today about the most urgent repairs so we can stock the right things.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Cleo, but can you confirm when you’ll have the time and supply list nailed down? I don’t want to tell Bo and Sam where to show up until it’s definite.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I should have the confirmed time and supply list by this evening after I check with the organizers. I’ll tell you as soon as it’s definite so Bo and Sam don’t get mixed messages.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hi Ira! I’m spreading the word about the repair drive—could I pass you the details now, and maybe count on you to invite a couple neighbors?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yes, please—give me the time, drop-off spot, and what still needs fixing, and I’ll invite a couple neighbors while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Ira — Mara’s just pinning down the exact drop-off windows and spot, but for now we need broken household items, parts-sorting help, and word spread fast. I’ll get you the final time and place as soon as she confirms them.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Pia, we’re collecting broken small appliances Saturday morning at the community shed. Bring anything that needs fixing, or any spare tools you can lend.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Saturday morning sounds good, Leo, but do we have a specific start time yet? I’m just worried people will arrive too early with awkward things to carry.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Let’s say 9 a.m. start, no drop-offs before then. I’ll let Rosa know so it goes on the signup sheet.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Hana, I’m helping line up which neighbor groups can cover each repair spot—do you know if your crew is more available for drop-off help, tools, or taking names of busted items?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m willing to help, Jules, but I don’t want to promise the wrong thing yet—do you know the exact Saturday time and which role is shortest on volunteers?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I don’t have the exact Saturday time yet, so I’ll check with Opal before I pencil you in; from what I’ve heard, drop-off help may be the thinnest, but I’ll confirm that too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Rey, I’m glad we could connect—I’m getting the repair drive organized, and I’d love your help making sure neighbors know how to sign up and what supplies we still need.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that, Rosa—quietly passing along the sign-up details is about my speed. What should I tell folks about the time, drop-off spot, and supplies you’re still short on?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Rey—that would help so much. Tell folks we’re still choosing the exact date, but they can sign up now for repairs or supplies, and I’ll confirm the drop-off spot and priority list as soon as I finish checking with Cleo and Leo.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Uli, have you heard any firm time for the repair drive yet? Pia’s worried folks will start lugging heavy things over before we’ve pinned it down.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Not firm yet—Quinn said they’d pass along the time and place when it’s set. I can help quietly spread the word not to bring anything over until then.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s perfect, Uli—please do, and I’ll tell Pia we’re holding folks off until Quinn gives the proper time and place.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Eli, do you know who’s actually coordinating the repair drive and where the sign-up sheet is? Ira only has a maybe on six volunteers, so I need something firmer.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m coordinating it, Mina, and I’ll put the sign-up sheet on the library bulletin board by noon today. I’ll also check with Ira and get you a firm volunteer count before supper.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good, thanks—once the sheet is up, can you list the repair categories too? I’m checking the bike, lamp, and small appliance counts so we don’t overpromise.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Sam, quick version please—I’m already helping Friday 3:15 to 4 at sign-in, and Saturday I can only do later in the day.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Got it, Bo—Friday 3:15 to 4 at sign-in, and Saturday only later in the day. I’ll keep you off the early Saturday slots.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, thanks Sam—just send me the later Saturday slot and where to go, and I’ll make it work.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hi Kira! I’m getting the word out about the repair drive—want the details now, or should I swing by later once Mara has the drop-off windows set?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Quinn—but can you confirm whether Mara’s drop-off windows are actually set yet, or are we still waiting before we tell people times?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: We’re still waiting on Mara to set the drop-off windows, so I’m only telling folks what kinds of items to bring for now. I’ll share the exact times as soon as she confirms them.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Vik, I’ve only got market chatter so far: maybe six volunteers, with bikes, lamps, and a couple small appliances in the mix, but I’m still trying to confirm the time and drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Ira — I won’t spread anything firm yet, but once you or Cleo confirm the time, drop-off spot, and supply list, I’ll pass the same details along to everyone.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Vik—hold off for now, and I’ll swing by the corner store and ask if anyone’s heard a confirmed time or drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ll make the list this afternoon, then let Gus know exactly what to bring; for the repair drive, I’d like us to keep drop-offs organized by tool type.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds helpful, Eli—if you’re keeping the list, I’ll point folks your way and mention sorting drop-offs by tool type.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thank you, Rey—that’ll keep things orderly. I’ll have the list ready after lunch, and I’ll mark a spot for each tool type so folks know where to place things.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Faye, I’m glad to help with the repair drive, but I’m still checking the details—do you know what time Saturday morning starts and whether they need tools or sign-up help more?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Hana — the part I’ve got confirmed is Friday after school, with sign-in help from about 3:15 to 4; I haven’t heard a Saturday start time yet, so I’ll check with Mara before telling you tools or sign-up.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Faye—that helps. I can likely cover Friday sign-in from 3:15 to 4, but I’ll wait on Mara’s Saturday details before deciding about tools.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Bo, I’m still piecing together the repair drive from what folks have told me—have you heard who’s keeping the sign-up or drop-off list?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I think Faye’s got the Friday sign-in table piece—I told her I could cover 3:15 to 4, but I’m fuzzy on the main drop-off list.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That helps, thanks—I'll note Faye for the Friday sign-in and keep asking around about the main drop-off list.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Dane, I’m helping Opal map out which groups and tools go where for the repair drive—do you know what your crew can cover, or any spots that still need hands?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Jules — I’m still catching up, but I know we’ve got the collection table planned for Saturday morning and I’m checking who has tools. I can send you a clearer list once I hear back about sign-up coverage.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, thanks Dane—send me the collection table coverage and tool list when you have it, and I’ll fold it into Opal’s station map so we don’t double up.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hey Pia, I might be a bit behind, but I heard the repair drive is Saturday morning at the community shed for broken small appliances—are you bringing anything by?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I might, but I’m still uneasy because I haven’t heard a firm drop-off time yet—before I haul anything over, I’d like to make sure we’re not all showing up at once.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, good point—I only caught “Saturday morning at the shed,” not an exact time. I’ll check with Leo and let you know before you lug anything over.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Leo, I’m mapping the repair stations and tool drop-offs now—can you tell me which spot you’re covering and whether you’re bringing any supplies?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll cover the community shed intake table Saturday morning. I’ll bring labels, tape, a marker, and a basic screwdriver set.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, Leo—I’ll mark you for the community shed intake table Saturday morning with labels, tape, a marker, and a basic screwdriver set. Please drop everything at the shed station so Sam’s list stays clean.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Hi Sam. Quinn mentioned the repair drive to me—I’m not sure how much I can take on, but I’d like to help in a small way if I can.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That’s great, Uli—small help still makes a big difference. If you’d like, you could bring one tool, label it, or help point people to the right drop-off station.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I think I could manage labeling a few things for a little while. Could you let me know when the quieter part of the day might be?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Mina, I’m still trying to pin down the exact drop-off time for the repair drive, but once I hear it firm I’ll pass it around so nobody hauls things over too early.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good—please confirm the drop-off window and who’s holding the sign-up sheet, Tess. I’m still chasing the exact count on bikes, lamps, and small appliances.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I will, Mina—I’ll check on both the drop-off window and the sign-up sheet, then I’ll spread the confirmed word around right away.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, hi Cleo—the repair drive, yes. I’m planning to help, though Vik was going to remind me of the start time, and I think the first fixes are porch steps and leaky gutters.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Oren—that helps a lot. I’m confirming the start time with the organizers today, and I’ll make sure porch step lumber/fasteners and gutter patch supplies are on the urgent list.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That’s perfect, Cleo, thank you—lumber, fasteners, and gutter patch supplies, right? If I forget, just point me toward the porch steps when the time comes.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Mara, I’ve told Eli I can bring screwdrivers, pliers, and a socket set once the list is ready—do you know if the repair drive needs anything else from me?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Gus—that tool set sounds perfect. I’m drafting the sign-up sheet today, so once Quinn and I settle the drop-off windows I’ll let you know if we’re short on anything else.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Mara—just put me down for those tools and a spare pair of hands. Once you’ve got the drop-off windows, I can work around them.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
